# AO scientific-owner disposition packet — r0.5

Status: recommended dispositions; owner approval requested; no option selected

These recommendations preserve observation/coadd separation, forbid automatic
fallback, and leave engineering representation choices downstream of
scientific authority.

| AO | Recommended owner disposition | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| AO-001-A | authorize as the sole optimal exact local constrained-GLS and reference-variance route when all premises hold | only this route may carry 'established_exact_local_GLS' and 'v_GLS,reference=d^-1' |
| AO-001-B | retain as successor-authorship trigger | not selectable until one exact structured covariance-derived weight is authored |
| AO-001-C | permit separately as 'radially_symmetrized_field_power_spectral_weighting' | normalized but nonoptimal; diagnostics are mandatory evidence fields, never admission thresholds; no noise, covariance, stationarity, or isotropy claim |
| AO-001-D | retain as successor-authorship trigger | no generic weaker-weight catch-all |
| AO-002 | select exact-operator numerical realization when a preregistered profile exists; otherwise unavailable | an intentionally distinct scientific operator requires separate owner authority and authorship |
| AO-003 | choose complete, projected, or unavailable separately for every named covariance role, then choose resident or lineage representation for available roles | scope is science; representation is engineering; AO-003-C does not erase exact-GLS reference variance |
| AO-004 | owner fixes the finite state-query vocabulary; engineering then chooses exact full, compact, or lineage representation | representation cannot select science |
| AO-005 | owner fixes response type, domain, query vocabulary, validity, and consumer scope; engineering then chooses exact representation | unsupported response queries remain unavailable |
| AO-006 | authorize the seven role meanings and dependency graph as normative; engineering chooses lossless storage/layout | no actionable scalar aggregate verdict |

The owner should also affirm that observation and coadd applications receive
separate dispositions/generations and that no route silently falls back.
